svg.title: A linear transformation
svg.desc: A coordinate grid with the basis vectors î and ĵ and the unit square. The matrix A with columns (2, 1) and (−1, 1) is written out, then the whole grid moves so that î lands on (2, 1) and ĵ on (−1, 1), and the unit square stretches into a parallelogram whose area, 3, is det A.
